description: Describes video entries shown on the video tab, with each line mapping a label to a YouTube URL or local video file.

type.title: string label before the first colon; can include / followed by display text
type.source: URL string or local .mp4 filename after the first colon
type.thumbnail: matching image filename from thumbnails.txt stored in video/pictures
type.thumbnailFormat: image display mode applied to all video thumbnails; options: cropped, full, fit
